arik: Hey team, I'm on my first day and hitting a strange error: npm rebuild fails with messages that look macOS/Xcode related inside the devcontainer. Anyone seen this?

mira: welcome! quick check: are you mounting your host home or ~/.asdf into the container?

arik: I did mount my home to get dotfiles easily.

julian: that's the usual culprit. Host shims or binaries (Darwin) can leak into a Linux container and break native builds. Avoid mounting ~/.asdf/installs or host bin dirs.

arik: ah that makes sense. I removed the host asdf mounts and ran `asdf install nodejs 20.3.1` inside the container. npm install finished.

infra-bot: FYI: infra recommends keeping mounts minimal (dotfiles only) and installing runtimes in-container. See: https://internal.redwood/infra/containers#host-artifacts

arik: thanks all — opening a tiny PR to add a note to .devcontainer/README about this. :thumbsup:
